definitions.explanation: A grammatical unit of language expressing a complete thought.
One's share or the quantity for a specific purpose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{短|みじか}い→みじかい：00510_mijikai⟧{文|ぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→かく：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{文|ぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→にほんご：00614_nihongo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{訳|やく}して→やくす：02319_yakusu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please translate this sentence into Japanese.

examples.japanese: {文|ぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{構造|こうぞう}→こうぞう：02730_kouzou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→ぶんせき：03610_bunseki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→ぶんぽう：01506_bunpou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→きほん：00226_kihon⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Analyzing sentence structure is fundamental to grammar.

examples.japanese: 3⟦{人|にん}→にん：00658_nin⟧{分|ぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→りょうり：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→ちゅうもん：03485_chuumon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I ordered food for three people.
examples.notes: 〜⟦{人|にん}→にん：00658_nin⟧{分|ぶん} = portion for ~ people

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→じぶん：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分|ぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→じぶん：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→はらう：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I'll pay for my own share.

examples.japanese: ⟦{余|あま}った→あまる：00001_amaru⟧{分|ぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→れいぞうこ：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→いれる：01098_ireru⟧⟦おいて→おく：01092_oku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put the leftover portion in the refrigerator.

notes:
Has two distinct uses: grammatical sentence and portion/share.

MEANING 1 - SENTENCE:
- ⟦{文|ぶん}{法|ぽう}→ぶんぽう：01506_bunpou⟧ (grammar)
- ⟦{文|ぶん}{型|けい}→ぶんけい：27004_bunkei⟧ (sentence pattern)
- ⟦{主|しゅ}{文|ぶん}→しゅぶん：noentry⟧ (main clause)
- ⟦{複|ふく}{文|ぶん}→ふくぶん：noentry⟧ (complex sentence)

MEANING 2 - PORTION/SHARE (as suffix):
- 〜⟦{人|にん}→にん：00658_nin⟧{分|ぶん} (for ~ people)
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→じぶん：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分|ぶん} (one's own share)
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→きょう：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分|ぶん} (today's portion)
- ⟦{余|あま}った→あまる：00001_amaru⟧{分|ぶん} (the leftover portion)

USAGE:
As a suffix meaning 'portion,' it often follows counters or nouns.
